name: BSP_PeerManager_PumpMessageQueues
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(void* peer) with ECX = game+1EF0h, ret at 0077648a. Returns at once when 00e188a8 is null. Picks the network object as peer+188h if set else peer+18Ch, then drains two locked queues on it: the 12-byte list at net+28h (head +2Ch, count +30h, CS +34h) running 00774ab0, 007752d0 and 007717a0 on each node[2]; and the list at net+18h (head +1Ch, count +20h, CS +24h) running 007702e0 when node[2]+D50h is set, then 00772ec0. The pseudocode shows a return after the first node, but the listing at 007762ff-00776309 falls into jmp 00776286, so each queue is drained fully. Between the queues, when peer+F4h is set, 01090ab0 virtual +20h gives a {counter, frequency} pair and a gap over 00d7a348 since 00e0af18 runs 00784c40 and 007850e0. Only reachable from BSP_Game_OnMove through the drain loop at 004e5462 that the decompiler removed as unreachable. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

Caller 00875bb0 at 00875e91 with ECX=00e188a8+1ef0h and the fixed step, behind the world gate; also BSP_Multiplayer_Tick 00778560, which passes the raw frame delta (docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md), and 00874d00. name: BSP_Session_RouteMessage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_unit_orders_apply, read-only analysis. void __thiscall(session = ECX, message = [esp+4], ...), body 0077C2A0..0077C469. Ghidra's pseudocode is wrong: it renders ECX as param_1 and the message as unaff_retaddr/unaff_EDI. Assembly 0077C2AB MOV EDI,ECX and 0077C2D0 MOV EBP,[ESP+18h] give the real binding. Requires game+5D4h >= 0Ah; derives routing flags from DAT_00E0AF1C and game+1FE4h, stamps msg+18h from sender+174h, sends to non-local peers through 00770B50 when hosting, and on the local bit calls 0076E520 to push the message into the session's own receive queue. 131 callers. docs/UNIT_STATE_MESSAGE.md

name: BSP_Entity_IssueCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(entity, void* command, const TargetDescriptor* target, int flags), RET 0Ch at 0077d7ea, 47 callers. Copies the 0x18-byte descriptor; when its kind byte is set and the object pointer is null it resolves the pointer from the uint16 id through the handle tables at 00f89a54/00f89aa8 (16-byte entries, pointer at +0Ch); asks 00521ea0's vtable[5Ch](0Fh) and on true retargets to singleton+9D4h with the zero vector 00f87574; calls 00a2bd90 when entity+16Ch is set and entity+284h is null or points back; then 007798d0, which builds a session message through 0075b430 BSP_SessionMessage_ConstructBase with the tag ' Mv', and BSP_Session_RouteMessage. Partial: the tables, the gate and the message layout are not reconstructed. docs/SCENE_DEFERRED_REFS.md. | Body now complete, 0077d600-0077d7ea. Corrections: 00521ea0 is not a singleton getter but the descriptor's own id-to-pointer resolver called with ECX = the local descriptor, so vtable[5Ch] is IsKindOf(0Fh) on the resolved target and the retarget source is target+9D4h, not singleton+9D4h; there is no ' Mv' tag, the message type byte is 58h = MT_COMMAND and 00d03630 is its vtable. The gate at 0077d776 compares command+4h against [00e08f7c], which is the ordinal field of the attackmove command object 00e08f78. The AI-group call at 0077d7a7 gets the caller's descriptor, not the retargeted local copy. 007798d0 builds the message on the stack at [ESP+30h] and 0077c2a0 routes it with the flag override 0. All 47 call sites tabulated; every constant flags argument is 1, and 005252ed passes playerUnit->IsKindOf(18h) instead. docs/ENTITY_ORDER_MESSAGE.md | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2l: 13 calls, one per Cruise record of usn_2_java.scn, each with flags 1 and a kind-0 descriptor. The AI-group notify at 0077d787..0077d7a3 was not reached on any of them: entity+16ch is null for every created instance because its only reconstructed producer is the AICreateGroup binding 00a38a50 through 00a2dfa0, and no installed mission script calls it.
